subject.title: docs: rebuild Doctor structured repair RFC 0004

question: Should this migrated RFC be recorded as completed with a canonical implementation issue, or remain accepted because meaningful implementation work is still outstanding?
rationale: The document claims the tracked migration is complete but intentionally leaves general repair dry-run for future work, so repository history alone cannot determine whether maintainers consider the RFC’s accepted scope fully implemented.

options.title: Record the RFC as completed
options.body: Link the canonical implementation issue and change the frontmatter to `status: completed`, keeping dry-run explicitly outside this RFC’s completed scope.

options.title: Keep the RFC accepted
options.body: Link an implementation issue and revise the completion language to identify the concrete accepted-scope work that remains unfinished.

recommendation.title: Record the RFC as completed
recommendation.body: Link the canonical implementation issue and change the frontmatter to `status: completed`, keeping dry-run explicitly outside this RFC’s completed scope.
